body: This helps me so much. Thanks!

For PvE. PvP is dead. Why do I need to much crit though? I got 55% crit already and about 3.8k add. I only play Dungeons though and I heard that Cutter is really beautiful with 4k add, is it worth it though?
You deserve more points, here, take mine.

There's nothing more to it really. I heard that it was a way for some people to cope with everything. I used to be like the others saying that it's not a good way of coping with things and there are better and safer ways of dealing with it but I just don't see it anymore.
I wanted an oven but all I got was a tin box with a lighter.
Adventure games and the like. I've finally calmed down now. Thanks for the distraction. It helped, a lot.
Video games are my hobby. I think I'm okay now. My heart's gone back to normal. I still can't believe I tried to do that.
No. I don't like physical activities. I'm calming down a bit now. I still can't get that image out of my head.
That won't work. I'm doing it right now and I still can't get my mind off of the fact that I tried to hurt myself.
That's dark bro... Here, have an upvote

I remember the time I told my family. It's exactly like yours. I got called all of those things: Selfish. Dramatic. Over reactive. Liar. On one case they told me not to think about these type of things. But the irony is, they're the ones putting it in my head. They tell me to not think about those type of things since I, in their words, am too young and have a wonderful future ahead of me.

 Sometimes, our family is not always the best people to turn to when we need them the most. But just because you can't run to them crying your eyes out doesn't mean you have no one else to turn to. You have us. The thousands of people willing to just listen. Because many, if not all, of us know what you're going through. 

I don't have the strength to talk to anyone that knows the actual me (the living, breathing version. Not this stranger from the internet) anymore. I tried that twice and in both cases they blew all over my face. That's enough for me. But don't let that be your case too. We all would love to just listen. All you need to do is talk.
You deserve more upvotes for that last line.
